Every group below is this deck's own functional set, not a role axis: the scaffold filed Glint-Horn Buccaneer and Irencrag Pyromancer under 'AN ANSWER — interaction of any kind' and Sticky Fingers under 'A FINISHER', which is what a `role:` derivation produces and why it was marked `scaffolded`. Names are the cards.json ' // ' form.
note: THE MACHINE. Both commanders are free (command zone), and between them they tax every card that moves: Brallin turns each DISCARD into 1 damage to EACH opponent and a +1/+1 counter; Shabraz turns each DRAW into a +1/+1 counter and 1 life. A wheel is therefore two payments, and the deck is the pile of cards that gets paid twice. Arithmetic, from the oracle text: one Wheel of Fortune with Brallin out is 7 to each opponent on the discard half; add Glint-Horn Buccaneer and it is 14; add Psychosis Crawler on the redraw and it is 21. Two wheels close a 40-life table. That is the declared win line and it is the reason `model_discard` is on.
_shuffle_note: THE HALF THE DECK GIVES AWAY, measured 2026-09-13. The 99 holds 17 hand-refill effects. NINE discard and therefore pay Brallin, Glint-Horn Buccaneer, Drake Haven, Containment Construct, Currency Converter and Rielle. SIX shuffle the hand into the library (Echo of Eons, Time Reversal, Commit // Memory, Winds of Change, Molten Psyche, Whirlpool Warrior) and TWO put it on the bottom (Arjun, Teferi's Puzzle Box); none of those eight is a discard and none of them pays any of those six cards. Priced at 4,000 games, seed 3: rewriting only the six shufflers to discard instead leaves card draw IDENTICAL at 14.78 extra cards by turn ten and moves cards discarded 7.58 -> 12.22 and cumulative per-opponent ping damage 9.61 -> 14.53. They refill exactly as well and pay half as much. A RANKING INPUT, not a cut list: shuffling the graveyard back is a real benefit these cards are bought for. THE GROUPS NAME THE DECK, NOT THE MODEL: three of the nine discard wheels (Burning Inquiry, Khorvath's Fury, Wheel of Misfortune) discard by oracle text and the SIMULATOR does not read any of them — Wheel of Misfortune is in `_WHEEL_EXCLUDED` as conditional, the other two match no wheel pattern. They are in the group because a target is a claim about the 99 and the scaffold's whole failure was deriving groups from what a tool could see. `model-coverage` and `meta.draw_not_modelled` are where the model's own blind spots are reported.
_flags_note: model_treasures is ON since 2026-10-04, by the pilot's ask: the deck's Treasure is readable now. Smothering Tithe makes a Treasure per opponent draw unless that opponent pays (TITHE_PAY_RATE 0.5, an AUTHORED assumption stated in MODEL_ASSUMPTIONS), Generous Plunderer's is an upkeep trigger, and Sticky Fingers' rides the combat channel. Treasure Map (landmark counters, transform) and Currency Converter (a discarded land) remain unmodelled and are named by model-coverage. Measured on the champion, same seed: damage@T10 60.88 -> 64.71, extra cards@T8 12.23 -> 12.89. model_sacrifice stays off: two DARK cards, neither a sacrifice engine.
_required_note: `required` marks what this deck cannot function without, and exactly ONE group carries it: a wheel. Every payoff here is a tax collector with nothing to tax until a hand empties and refills. `route` marks the two ways this deck closes, counted as a UNION rather than multiplied.

targets.label: A WHEEL drawn — the ignition; nothing else in the deck starts itself
A DISCARD wheel drawn — the half that pays Brallin (six more shuffle or bottom and pay him nothing)
A second per-discard DAMAGE source drawn (doubles Brallin's half of every wheel)
A per-draw DAMAGE source drawn (taxes the refill half)
A discard converted to board or cards (the non-damage half of the tax)
A per-draw BOARD source drawn (the air force the commanders fly with)
THE WHEEL KILL — a DISCARD wheel plus a stacked per-card damage source
THE AIR KILL — a wheel plus a flying body that grows on every card
Ramp drawn — an accelerant of any kind, five of the seven of them Treasure the model is not reading
Commander protection drawn — the whole engine is one 4-drop that dies to everything
A real answer drawn — a counter, a sweeper or a tax
Hand-size relief drawn — no maximum hand size, so a wheel's seven survives the cleanup step
